title: SIDE STORY: GUIDE AHEAD RERUN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: GUIDE AHEAD RERUN
EVENT DURATION: September 21, 2023, 10:00 – October 5, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Guide Ahead event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming them from the event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
- [Summit of Nations] Duration:
- [Road to the Shine] Duration:
[NOTARIAL TASKS]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Notarial Tasks] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS:
★★★★★ : Enforcer, Laterano Notarial Hall Lounge Furniture (Pieces), Etched Bullet Casings.
[LATERANIAN DESSERTS]
DURATION: September 21, 2023, 10:00 – October 5, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Etched Bullet Casings by clearing event stages. Etched Bullet Casings can be used to redeem items from [Lateranian Desserts].
MAIN REWARDS: Enforcer’s Token, Laterano Notarial Hall Lounge Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

- The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
- Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
- This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

- The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Exchange Info] for more details.
- [Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
- Operators Fiammetta, Enforcer, and Kazemaru will gain more trust during the event rerun.
- The event stages will be permanently added to [Side Story] after the end of the event at 04:00 on October 5 (UTC-7).
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – FLAME OF IMMACULACY
DURATION: September 21, 2023, 10:00 – October 5, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting [Flame of Immaculacy] opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Fiammetta
★★★★★: Kazemaru / Executor
NOTE: [Flame of Immaculacy] is a Standard Headhunting
03 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: September 21, 2023, 10:00 - October 5, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Paper Wing for Enforcer
04 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: September 21, 2023, 10:00 - October 5, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Epoque Collection - Appreciate Fragrance for Saileach
Epoque Collection - Plant Crude Drug for Mulberry
Epoque Collection - Cultivate Vegetation for Tuye
05 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – LATERANO NOTARIAL HALL LOUNGE
DURATION: September 21, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - October 5, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Guide Ahead event rewards and redeemable from [Lateranian Desserts] (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces) from September 21, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) to October 5, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
